Appearance:
 Shri Nipun Choudhary, Advocate for the applicant.
 Shri Rahul Solanki, Government Advocate for the non-a
None for the prosecutrix, though served.
ORDER Heard with the aid of case diary.

This is first application filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail to the applicant/accused,
in connection with FIR/Crime No.305/2024 dated (not mentioned) registered at Police Station Badnawar, District Dhar (M.P.) for commission of offence punishable under Sections 363, 366-A,
368, 376, 376(2)(n) and 34 of IPC alongwith 3, 4 and 5(l)/6 of the POCSO Act.
2. Prosecution story, in brief is that at the time of incident, prosecutrix was minor girl aged around 17 years.
On 30.04.2024 when the prosecutrix was sleeping at her house.

at around 9-10 PM,
co-accused Lakhan and Rahul @ Suraj came there and co-accused Lakhan inserted NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-IND:26736 2 MCRC-39670-2024 handkerchief in her mouth and forcibly took the prosecutrix outside the house where co-accused persons namely, Radheshyam,
Suresh Singh and present applicant Raghunath were present thereafter
, the aforesaid accused persons took the prosecutrix to farmland of Hemant Patel where Ramkanyabai and Sitaram were present.
Co-accused Suresh Singh gave Rs.20,000/- to co-accused Lakhan for his expenditure.

Thereafter, co- accused Rahul @ Suraj and Lakhan took the prosecutrix to Dewas by motor cycle thereafter, co-accused Lakhan took the prosecutrix to another places and kept her alongwith him for Raghunath vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/90368169/
1 around 15 to 20 days.

sentences.text: Meanwhile, co-accused Lakhan committed rape upon the prosecutrix repeatedly.
Lastly, when the co-accused was sleeping in the room then prosecutrix ran away from there and returned back to her home.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant/accused submits that applicant has not committed the offence and has falsely been implicated in the case.
The case of present applicant is identical to that of co-accused person Rahul @ Suraj, who has been enlarged on bail vide order dated 04.09.2024 passed by this Court in MCRC No.36415/2024.
Applicant is in custody since 08.08.2024.
After completion of investigation, charge-sheet has been filed.
Conclusion of trial will take considerable long time for its disposal.
Therefore, on the ground of parity with co-accused persons it is prayed that applicant be released on bail.
4. On the other hand, learned counsel for the non-applicant/State has opposed the prayer and prayed for rejection of the application.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-IND:26736 3 MCRC-39670-2024 5.

Having considered the rival submissions and after perusal of the case diary so also considering the facts and circumstances of the case, without commenting on the merits of the case, on the ground of parity with co-accused person, this Court is of the view that applicant deserves to be enlarged on bail hence, the application is allowed.
6.

It is directed that applicant - Raghunath shall be released on bail upon his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned Trial Court for his appearance before the Trial Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this behalf by the Trial Court during pendency of the trial.
It is further directed that applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) of Criminal Procedure Code, 1973.
7. This order shall be effective till the end of trial but in case of bail jump, it shall become ineffective.
8. With the aforesaid, this application is allowed and stands disposed of.
Certified copy, as per Rules.
